set.pl: Miller family farmhouse, N half of sec. 22 T3S R16W (Hartford Twp), just east of the N-S half line about 0.33 mi south of the north line (1873 and 1895 Van Buren atlases); Cora's own forty in 1895 was the NW quarter of the NW quarter of sec. 22, across from Maple Hill Cemetery (centre about 42.1986,-86.1643)
set.st: Cora Miller, daughter of a Hartford farmer, died March 1897; her last words were "Seventeen hundred dollars, dig, dig." Two separate Paw Paw papers reported it the same week. The family farm is on the 1873 and 1895 Van Buren County atlases, and by 1895 Cora held her own forty at its NW corner.
set.t: Search around the old farmhouse site and Cora's forty to the NW. Maple Hill Cemetery across the road is look-only. Private land: ask permission first.
acc: Private farm: ask permission first. Cemetery across the road: look only.
pinev: Farmhouse on the 1873 and 1895 Van Buren County atlases, placed from the BLM PLSS grid (about 200 m); Cora's 1895 forty (NW¼ NW¼ sec. 22) lies about 700 m NW
Two separate local accounts (True Northerner and Courier-Northerner, Paw Paw, 24 Mar 1897)

src: Atlas of Van Buren County (1873) and Van Buren County atlas (1895), Hartford Township
